title: Chapter 162 What Happened
content:
Chapter 162 What Happened

The imperial capital of the Divine Dynasty.

After a while, the entire void finally returned to its former peace.

But everyone still couldn't let go of the terrifying sword.

Is that really the power that can appear in this world?

"Big, Miss."

At this time, the man in the Divine Prison walked to Lu Xue with a nervous mood.

When Lu Xue heard this, she turned her head and looked at him.

Suddenly, the man couldn't help but tremble all over.

"Miss, do you have any instructions? If so, I'll do it right away."

Hearing this, Lu Xue immediately understood.

The man in front of him no longer wanted to return to the divine prison.

But after he came out, he did nothing, so he needed a chance to stay outside.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue slowly said, "The crisis here has been resolved, but the matter on the border should not be over yet."

"You understand what I mean?"

Hearing this, the man nodded repeatedly.

"Miss, I'll go to the border to support you now."

At this time, several crying came from afar. Lu Xue looked back and saw that they were the strong men from the Divine Prison.

"And we, let's go too!"

In this way, these powerful people from the Divine Prison rushed towards the unknown boundary under the leadership of a general of the Divine Dynasty.

For sneaking away.

They didn't dare to think about it, because the terrifying sword had penetrated into their hearts.

Standing in the void, Lu Xue looked calmly at the direction of the unknown border.

At this moment, the void suddenly cracked open on the side, and then a strong man from the Divine Dynasty, covered in blood and a suffocating breath, suddenly appeared in front of Lu Xue.

"you?"

When Lu Xue saw the person in front of him, he was shocked.

At this time, Mr. Zhou appeared beside Lu Xue.

"Guan Lin, what happened there? Where is Shen Yi?"

The powerful man from the Divine Dynasty in front of him was a young general following the first Divine Dynasty and next to the Divine Dynasty.

When Guan Lin, the rough man, heard Mr. Zhou's question, burst into tears.

"Your Highness, Old Zhou, the Great General of God, died in battle on an unknown border in order to cover us!"

"What?!"

Hearing Guan Lin's words, Old Zhou suddenly lost his voice and stood there in a daze.

God was killed in a battle!

Why, why are you only receiving the message now?

Immediately, Old Zhou's eyes suddenly burst into pieces and grabbed Guan Lin's shoulder, "Then why are you rushing back now? Shen Yi tried his best to cover you up. Didn't he just want you to send the news back soon?!"

At this moment, Old Zhou was trembling all over.

If His Majesty knew that God was killed, he would not know what else would happen.

That was the first strong man to follow His Majesty. In terms of sincerity, he even felt ashamed of himself.

At this moment, Shen Yi actually died in battle at an unknown border.

"Old Zhou."

At this time, Lu Xue, who had been silent on the side, suddenly pressed Mr. Zhou's shoulder.

"Old Zhou, calm down."

Upon hearing this, Old Zhou looked dim and then let go of Guan Lin and retreated aside.

Lu Xue walked to Guan Lin and handed Guan Lin a pill.

"Eat it first."

Guan Lin looked at Lu Xue gratefully, and then quickly stuffed the pill into his mouth.

He was really almost exhausted to get here.

When the pill entered the mouth, a huge amount of medicinal power swept across the body.

In just a blink of an eye, Guan Lin's injuries and physical strength began to recover quickly.

"Subordinate, thank you for giving the medicine to your princess!"

"alright."

Lu Xue waved her hand and said expressionlessly: "Tell me quickly, why are you back now, and what about the others?"

Listening to Guan Lin's words, the god of God faced the sudden attack of the Spirit-Devouring Clan at another border and chose to die in exchange for the lives of others.

If Guan Lin and others could come back quickly at that time, they would not only be able to prepare in advance, but they might even go to the border to support it.

But the result was that Guan Lin only arrived until this Spirit-Devouring Army died here tragically.

When Guan Lin heard Lu Xue’s question, his eyes suddenly turned red.

"Your Highness Princess, the Great General of God is alone facing the Spirit-Devouring Army, while we are rushing back to the imperial capital to prepare defensive measures to resist the enemy."

"But unexpectedly, when we returned halfway, we suddenly met a mysterious strong man."

Speaking of this, a hint of fear appeared in Guan Lin's eyes.

"The other party blocked our army halfway with his own strength. In the end, I was the only one who survived by chance."

Guan Lin knelt in the void, looking extremely painful.

After listening to Guan Lin's words, Lu Xue and Old Zhou both looked a little ugly.

"Do you know who that mysterious strong man is?"

Guan Lin shook his head and was about to speak, but suddenly he was stunned.

"Are you looking for me?"

boom!

Old Zhou suddenly burst out his breath and blocked Lu Xue.

Ao Qing also suddenly appeared, listening to the mysterious powerful man in the void in front of him with a cautious expression.

Lu Xue turned around and saw a man with a pair of red eyes standing in the void, looking at everyone with a faint smile.

"Your Highness, it's him!"

On the side, Guan Lin suddenly exclaimed, looking at the man with red pupils, and murderous intent gushed.

Hearing this, Lu Xue said in a deep voice: "Who are you?"

The man with red eyes smiled unabated, "Damn, I don't need to know my identity, and I don't have the right to know."

As soon as these words came out, everyone suddenly looked solemn.

At the same time, a large number of powerful people from the Divine Dynasty rushed here.

"What is your purpose?"

Lu Xue continued to ask.

Hearing Lu Xue's question, the red-eyed man laughed.

"Purpose? Actually, I just like the feeling of killing. I think I share the same interests with the Soul Devouring Clan."

Killing.

This is his way.

A very extreme way.

But it is because of this that the red-eyed man can reach this level of strength.

In the void, Lu Xue nodded, and just as she was about to speak, she suddenly looked behind the red-eyed man absent-mindedly.

At the same time, a cold voice sounded from behind the red-eyed man.

"Hey, why are you pretending in front of my daughter?"

Suddenly, the red-eyed man's face changed drastically.

.........

Another border battlefield.

At this moment, the battlefield was in a mess.

"Woman, by now, your nest may have been razed by my Soul Devouring Clan army, right?"

The mocking voice of the Soul Devouring Clan sounded from the void.

The faces of the people from the Divine Dynasty suddenly became gloomy.

But for some reason, Yan Lingyun was not much moved.

Even the attack was not as urgent as at the beginning.

Even so, the Devouring Spirit was still suppressed.

Until now, the Devouring Spirit was almost hanging on with one breath.

Seeing that Yan Lingyun had no reaction, the Devouring Spirit's face was a little ugly.

At this point, he already had an ominous premonition.

Sure enough.

The space in the distance suddenly cracked.

The next moment, two familiar figures appeared in front of the Devouring Spirit.

It was Devouring Jin and Devouring Heng.

"Clan, clan leader."

Seeing the two, the Devouring Spirit's face was gloomy. He had guessed something, but no matter how hard he thought, he couldn't figure out why he failed.

"What happened?"

The Devouring Spirit said in a deep voice.

And Yan Lingyun also stopped attacking, standing in the void and looking at the three Devouring Spirits indifferently.
